## Status
Implementation is complete.

## Conclusion
We decided to use ORGBRAIN_API_URL as the canonical variable.

## Reason
This prevents two configuration names from diverging across adapters.

## Reuse
When a connector or hook is added, read the endpoint from ORGBRAIN_API_URL.

## Evidence
packages/shared/src/index.ts and packages/orgbrain-cli/src/hook-memory-bridge.mjs.

The Stop hook must send exactly one batch request because tool discovery adds unnecessary latency. Evidence: scripts/hook-memory-bridge.test.mjs and packages/orgbrain-cli/src/hook-memory-bridge.mjs. When another lifecycle hook is added, send its candidates in one batch request.
Implementation completed; commit, push, CI, and build all succeeded.
